All 16 tests pass now; 4 were failing before. I changed two files under `slugkit/`, which is the only path the task allows, and didn't commit anything.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `slugkit/slug.py` | Accented letters were dropped instead of folded to ASCII, so "Crème" became `cr-me` (spec 1.1). | Decompose accented letters with `unicodedata.normalize("NFKD")`, then drop whatever isn't ASCII. |
| `slugkit/slug.py` | Each punctuation character got its own separator instead of each run getting one, so "Rock & Roll" became `rock---roll` (spec 1.2). | Changed the pattern `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+`. |
| `slugkit/truncate.py` | Off by one: a separator sitting exactly at position `max_len` was ignored, so the cut landed one word too early (spec 2.2). | `rfind(sep, 0, max_len)` → `rfind(sep, 0, max_len + 1)`. |
